title: Replace remaining bg-white classes in shop components with bg-zinc-950
body:
The shop theme still had light-mode backgrounds leaking through on a dark page: `html, body` forced a global `text-zinc-100`, and 33 `bg-white` classes remained across the Blade component tree.

### Changes

- **`Resources/assets/css/app.css`** — `html, body` now sets only the background; the global text color is dropped so components control their own foreground.

  ```diff
   html,
   body {
  -    @apply bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-100;
  +    @apply bg-zinc-950;
   }
  ```

- **`Resources/views/components/**`** — all `bg-white` → `bg-zinc-950` (15 files: accordion, categories/carousel, datagrid table + toolbar, form control-group, image-zoomer, header/mobile, products/card, range-slider, shimmers). Covers variant-prefixed forms (`after:`, `[&::-webkit-slider-thumb]:`, `[&::-moz-range-thumb]:`, `[&::-ms-thumb]:`) and the alpha form `bg-white/80` → `bg-zinc-950/80`. `grep -rn bg-white views/components/` is now empty.

### Notes for review

- `layouts/header/index.blade.php` already read `bg-zinc-950` before this PR — it never contained `bg-white`. The only white in the header tree was a mobile CTA button (`layouts/header/mobile/index.blade.php:101`), now dark. That button still carries `text-navyBlue` / `border-navyBlue`, so contrast there likely needs a follow-up.
- Consequently, a white header on the live site points at stale compiled output (Tailwind bundle in `public/build`, `storage/framework/views`, or CDN), not this source. These class changes require a Tailwind rebuild to take effect; no build was run here per the request.
- Blanket replacement also darkened elements where white was intentional contrast — range-slider thumbs, the toggle knob (`after:bg-white`), and the product-card badge overlay (`bg-zinc-950/80` sitting next to `!border-white`). Worth a visual pass to confirm these read correctly.
